description: Governance allowlist of MCP servers vetted for use in this project. The `mcp-security-audit` skill (Check 5) flags any server in .mcp.json whose name is absent here or whose pinned version is not allowed. Adding a server here is a security decision: it must be pinned (never @latest), take secrets only via ${ENV} references, and have a recorded rationale + source.

policy.version_note: pinned_version values below are EXAMPLE pins. Before adopting a server, verify the current release on the official MCP registry (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) and update the pin to a verified version + digest where available.

approved_servers.name: filesystem
approved_servers.rationale: Scoped file access for the orchestrator. MUST be restricted to explicit roots (repo path); never grant home or system roots.

approved_servers.name: git
approved_servers.rationale: Read/search git history for artifact-first evidence (commit-range replay, diff inspection). Read-mostly; do not expose destructive operations.

approved_servers.name: fetch
approved_servers.rationale: HTTP content extraction for research. SSRF surface: keep loopback/internal-host fetches disabled; treat fetched content as untrusted input (subject to the prompt-injection policy, TASK-1021 Rule-3/4).

approved_servers.name: memory
approved_servers.rationale: Knowledge-graph memory across sessions. NOTE: per the artifact-first principle, artifacts remain the single source of truth; memory is a convenience cache, not authoritative state (cf. FIND-24 memory-poisoning).

approved_servers.name: sequential-thinking
approved_servers.rationale: Explicit step-by-step reasoning aid for complex governance/red-team decisions. No external side effects.

approved_servers.name: github
approved_servers.rationale: Official GitHub MCP server for PR/issue/CI visibility and artifact evidence (github-pr replay). HIGH risk: grant least-privilege, read-only/fine-grained tokens; never write scopes unless a task requires it.

approved_servers.name: tavily
approved_servers.rationale: Web search/extract for the research phase (the project already uses Tavily via the Gemini wrapper). Results are untrusted external content (prompt-injection policy applies).
